profile_text.body:
Boston Consulting Group is a global consulting firm, according to its website, that works with leaders in business and society. The site describes its work as combining strategy, execution, and technology, and says it partners with organizations on transformation, capability building, and applied AI. It is a for-profit company and its website is bcg.com.

AI is presented on the site as a central part of that work. BCG says it helps clients scale artificial intelligence for competitive advantage and grounds consumer-focused innovation in data, analytics, and AI. The site cites client examples, including a technology firm that used AI and data-driven decision-making to rework productivity at scale, a mining operation in Western Australia that worked with BCG X on an AI scheduling platform, and PHOENIX group, which the site says used AI to streamline supply chains and cut costs. The site also notes that AI and shifting market dynamics are reshaping dealmaking and value creation as large deals rebound.

The site's own material does not name specific AI products, and no litigation, regulatory filings, or other third-party records about the company are part of the available information.
